## Outcome

Describe the developer or maintainer problem this pull request solves.

## Approach

Summarize the implementation and important tradeoffs. Link the relevant task, issue, or ADR when one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Documentation is updated when commands or behavior changed.
- [ ] User-visible changes include appropriate screenshots or recordings.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, or fabricated product claims are included.

## Scope check

- [ ] This change implements documented behavior or clearly labels planned behavior.
- [ ] Breaking architectural decisions include an ADR or explicit maintainer discussion.
